integrity: All 100 usable PRE input sets and Frozen B1a rankings were constructed before the dedicated result-page scoring phase in each run. Because historical source pages may themselves contain outcome-bearing material, KR-015 keeps this evidence retrospective rather than upgrading it to blind/prospective evidence.
scientific_findings: The previous small-sample impression of uniformly strong Frozen B1a performance does not generalize across this fixed 100-race universe.
Performance is materially heterogeneous by venue and exact circumference; venue/circumference structure must be treated as a primary research dimension rather than pooled away.
400m is materially stronger than 333.3m in this batch, while 335m is intermediate on top1 but weaker on winner-Top3; no retuning is authorized from this confirmatory batch.
Takeo/Aomori/Kawasaki are strong in this batch while Gifu/Matsuyama/Yahiko are weak; this must be replicated on independent dates before any venue-specific rule is adopted.
next: Build an independent historical universe on different dates and repeat without retuning.
Predeclare venue/circumference/race-type subgroup analyses and test whether the large venue differences replicate.
Use the historical virtual world to test ticket construction and bankroll rules only after ranking/probability stability is characterized.
